name: Password Recovery Unknown Account
summary: Deprecated. Unknown-account recovery requests are an internal security-sensitive permutation of Password Recovery Success because the public response and next user-visible state are intentionally identical to a known-account request.
finalOutcome: Superseded as a canonical behavior; unknown-account request handling remains runtime evidence beneath Password Recovery Success.

sourceReferences.note: SendResetPasswordLinkAsync returns public success when no account resolves and creates no recovery code, preserving account non-disclosure.

Deprecated as a separate behavior because behavior identity follows materially different user-visible auth states; known-account and unknown-account recovery requests intentionally share the same public outcome.
